docs.question: Do you offer free landscaping estimates?
docs.answer: Yes. We can review your property, discuss your goals, and provide a clear estimate before any work begins.

docs.question: What landscaping services do you provide?
docs.answer: We offer landscape design, lawn and garden care, planting, hardscaping, seasonal maintenance, and outdoor improvements.

docs.question: How long does a landscaping project take?
docs.answer: Timelines depend on the size and scope of the project. We'll give you a clear schedule before work starts.

docs.question: Can you work with my existing landscape?
docs.answer: Absolutely. We can refresh, extend, or redesign around what you already have — keeping what works and improving the rest.

docs.question: Do you offer ongoing lawn maintenance?
docs.answer: Yes. We offer routine and seasonal maintenance plans to keep your lawn and garden healthy year-round.

docs.question: How do I get started?
docs.answer: Contact us to request a free estimate. We'll schedule an on-site consultation and walk you through the next steps.
